plan: Given my private value of $21, I will aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit if I win. Bidding $20.9 is optimal since it is the maximum non-dominated bid, ensuring profit if I win and the second-highest bid is below $20.9. This bid minimizes the risk of overpaying relative to my value and maximizes potential profit.

Given my private value of $16, I should aim to bid slightly below this value to maximize profit if I win, while not overbidding and risking a loss. Bidding my exact value or higher could result in zero or negative profit if I win. A bid of $15.9 is strategic, as it is close to my value and increases chances of winning while ensuring some profit if the second-highest bid is lower. This approach avoids dominated bids by not exceeding my value, thus securing a positive outcome.

Given my value of $17, I should aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit. Bidding exactly $17 could lead to a break-even situation if the second-highest bid matches mine. To avoid dominated strategies, bidding above $17 is unwise since it could lead to a loss. I will bid slightly above the midpoint of $0 and $17 to outbid competitors but stay profitable. A bid of $15.5 balances the risk of overbidding and the chance of winning, assuming others bid randomly between $0 and $20.
